arguments.sql:
SELECT c.gender, MIN(c.birth_date) AS first_birth_date, MAX(c.birth_date) AS last_birth_date,
       COUNT(*) AS links, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS clients,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT a.district_id) AS districts,
       SUM(c.birth_date IS NOT DATE(c.birth_date)) AS non_iso_dates
FROM main.client AS c
JOIN main.disp AS p ON p.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN main.account AS a ON a.account_id = p.account_id
WHERE c.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
GROUP BY c.gender
